newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates drop, bank reserves seen full.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates drop, bank reserves seen full.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates eased slightly on Thursday in slow trading as banks began to finish filling their reserves before the end of the two-week reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight rates opened at 21.25 percent and closed at about 21.00 percent, down from Wednesday's finish of 21.125 percent. Dealers said at least one deal was struck at 20.875 percent.
They said that in the past few days demand from banks replenishing their reserves kept the overnight rates at levels above 21 percent.
"They did not want to do it next week, at the end of the reserve period," said Istvan Zsoter of Takarekbank, adding that Hungary will have four-day holidays from next Thursday.
Banks which fill their reserves only next Wednesday, will have to borrow money and pay interest for five days, and suffer losses if the interest rates will be high, he said.
But dealers said they saw less borrowers on the market on Thursday than in the past few days and that may indicate that most banks already fulfilled the reserve requirements.
In that case the overnight rates may drop slightly in the next few days, dealers added.
